articles.title: Shraddha Kapoor Posted a Dance Video at 40. The Internet Told Her She Was Too Old. Here's Why That Matters.

articles.nri_angle: The ageism Shraddha faced mirrors pressures NRI women experience in their own communities — expectations to 'act your age,' disappear from public life after 35, and conform to cultural norms around aging that clash with Western values of self-expression. Bollywood's treatment of its actresses is a cultural export the diaspora consumes and internalizes.
